connector.name: Playwright Report MCP
connector.registryDescription: Run Playwright tests and surface structured results for AI agents doing test failure analysis.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package playwright-report-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hubertgajewski account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: PW_ALLOWED_DIRS
env.description: path.delimiter-separated list of directories the per-call workingDirectory parameter may point at. Entries may be absolute or relative (resolved once against the server's launch cwd at startup). Defaults to '.' (authorizes only the launch directory).

env.name: PW_RESULTS_FILE
env.description: Absolute path override for the JSON reporter output file. Defaults to <workingDirectory>/test-results/results.json, computed per call.
